effects.name: SkillDamageData.SetAbnormalType
effects.when: PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Stop, stopPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount lt 1 OR 1 ge damageCount AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Stop, stopPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount ge 1 OR 1 lt damageCount AND 2 ge damageCount AND PlayerAttackBase.checkAbnormalPercent(this, AbnormalType.Stop, stopPercent, playerAction) AND damageCount ge 1
